customer_message.subject: chat – mould, boiler, rent
customer_message.body:
Maeve Holm: hi there. I rent a 3.5-room at Rebbergstrasse 93 in Steffisburg from Hausverwaltung Pilatus AG
Maeve Holm: grey-green mould all over the bathroom ceiling and the hallway smells musty
Maeve Holm: and the boiler cuts out at night, bedrooms are cold every morning, heating basically doesn't work at night
Maeve Holm: Pilatus sent a painter for the ceiling and a plumber for the boiler and each one said it's the other one's problem. the plumber literally said "you need someone who can measure the walls and the ventilation, that's not my job"
Maeve Holm: I'm going to pay my rent into the official deposit account from November. I've had enough. how do I do that correctly?
